name: Leaf on Fire
source:
Leaf on Fire is a Poke parody game following Leaf as she embarks on the journey to become the greatest trainer the world has ever seen. On the way she will face weird situations and will have to give all the love her little creatures deserve, so they can grow strong and healthy.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/ThunderOne]Patreon[/url]]

Further development of the game has been discontinued due to a copyright claim by Nintendo.
translation:
Leaf on Fire是一款Poke模仿游戏，跟随Leaf踏上成为世界上最伟大训练家的旅程。一路上她将面临奇怪的情况，并且必须给予她的小动物应有的所有爱，这样它们才能坚强健康地成长。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/ThunderOne]Patreon[/url]]

由于任天堂的版权主张，该游戏的进一步开发已停止。
